hook: Hsu came to formal verification from finance and philanthropy. A former managing director at Citadel Investment Group and CEO of Kilometre Capital, he funds AI safety work through the Infinitude Foundation and sits on the Lean FRO's strategic advisory board, and in 2026 he co-founded &Truth to make provably safe code a practical standard.
name: Chris Hsu

quote.text: In the AI era, even 99% safe is certainly broken.

moniker: Co-founder, co-CEO and executive chairman of &Truth

secondary.name: TokenPost, &Truth Raises $70 Million to Automate Formal Software Verification, 2026-10-29
The New York Times, Cade Metz, After Reinventing Mathematics, Can A.I. Eradicate Computer Bugs?, 2026-10-29

timeline.event: Co-founds &Truth with Clark Barrett and Ilya Sergey; it emerges from stealth on October 29
timeline.impact: Brings formal verification of software to a funded company

quick_facts: Co-Founder, Co-CEO and Executive Chairman of &Truth, PBC
President of the Infinitude Foundation, which funds AI safety work
Member of the Strategic Advisory Board of the Lean Focused Research Organization (Lean FRO)
Previously CEO of Kilometre Capital and Managing Director at Citadel Investment Group

achievements.title: Co-founding &Truth (2026)
achievements.impact: Raised $70 million in seed funding to build a universal verification machine for code.

achievements.title: Lean FRO Strategic Advisory Board
achievements.impact: Advises the nonprofit that develops the Lean theorem prover and programming language.
